title: Patterns (2): 一个一个, 个个 / 天天, 想…就…, 多长时间…一次, 一方面…另一方面, 不是不, A是A
description: One by one, every single, as you like, how often, on the one hand / on the other, double negation, and conceding a point.

points.title: 一 + MW + 一 + MW: one by one
points.summary: 一个一个, 一口一口 = one at a time.
examples: {他|tā}{一口一口|yì kǒu yì kǒu}{地|de}{吃|chī}。

points.title: 个个 / 天天 / 人人: every single
points.summary: Doubling a measure word = every single one, usually with 都.
points.body:
- 我们班的学生**个个**都很聪明.
- 他**天天**都去跑步.
examples: He goes running every single day.

points.title: 想 + QW + 就 + QW: whatever you like
points.summary: 想吃什么就吃什么 = eat whatever you want. The same question word appears twice.
examples: Today you can eat whatever you like.

points.title: 多长时间 + verb + 一次?: how often
points.summary: Subject + 多长时间 + verb + 一次 (+ object)? Answer: 一个月一次 etc.
points.body: - 你**多长时间**去**一次**超市?
examples: How often do you go home?

points.title: 一方面 … 另一方面 …
points.summary: 一方面 A，(另)一方面 B = on the one hand … on the other (two sides or two reasons).
points.body: - 我学中文，**一方面**是因为工作，**另一方面**是因为我喜欢中国文化.
examples: {他|tā}{一方面|yì fāngmiàn}{要|yào}{工作|gōngzuò}，{一方面|yì fāngmiàn}{要|yào}{照顾|zhàogù}{孩子|háizi}。
He has to work on the one hand, and look after the children on the other.

points.title: 不是不 …: it's not that … not
points.summary: 不是不 + verb = it's not that (I) don't … — there's another reason.
points.body: - 我**不是不**想去，是没有时间.
examples: It's not that I don't want to go — I just don't have time.

points.title: A 是 A，但是 / 就是 …: sure, but
points.summary: Adj + 是 + same adj，但是 / 就是 … = it is …, but ….
points.body: - 这件衣服好看**是**好看，**但是**太贵了.
examples: It's good, sure, just a bit pricey.

notes: 每个一个 isn't the pattern.
个个一个 isn't the pattern.
几个一个 isn't the pattern.
questions.translation: Don't rush — please come in one at a time.

questions.translation: Every single student in our class is clever.

questions.prompt: {我|wǒ}{学|xué}{中文|Zhōngwén}，{一方面|yì fāngmiàn}{是|shì}{因为|yīnwèi}{工作|gōngzuò}{需要|xūyào}，（　）{是|shì}{因为|yīnwèi}{我|wǒ}{喜欢|xǐhuan}{中国|Zhōngguó}{文化|wénhuà}。
notes: 另一边 = 'the other side (place)'.
一边 pairs with 一边 (simultaneous actions).
方面 alone isn't the pattern.
questions.translation: I'm learning Chinese partly because I need it for work, and partly because I love Chinese culture.

options: {他|tā}{方面|fāngmiàn}{一|yī}{要|yào}{工作|gōngzuò}，{方面|fāngmiàn}{一|yī}{要|yào}{照顾|zhàogù}{孩子|háizi}。
{他|tā}{一方面|yì fāngmiàn}{要|yào}{工作|gōngzuò}，{一边|yìbiān}{要|yào}{照顾|zhàogù}{孩子|háizi}。
{一方面|yì fāngmiàn}{他|tā}{要|yào}{工作|gōngzuò}{一方面|yì fāngmiàn}，{要|yào}{照顾|zhàogù}{孩子|háizi}。
{他|tā}{一方面|yì fāngmiàn}{要|yào}{工作|gōngzuò}，{一方面|yì fāngmiàn}{要|yào}{照顾|zhàogù}{孩子|háizi}。
notes: The order is 一方面.
一方面 pairs with (另)一方面, not 一边.
Each 一方面 introduces its own clause.
questions.translation: He has to work on the one hand, and look after the children on the other.

questions.prompt: What does 「{我|wǒ}{不是|búshì}{不|bù}{想|xiǎng}{去|qù}，{是|shì}{没有|méiyǒu}{时间|shíjiān}。」 mean?
notes: 不是不 cancels the 'don't want'.
The reason is time, not wanting.
没有时间 = no time.

questions.prompt: {他|tā}{不是|búshì}（　）{喜欢|xǐhuan}{你|nǐ}，{只是|zhǐshì}{不好意思|bù hǎoyìsi}{说|shuō}。
notes: 非 isn't used like this.
不是没喜欢 isn't natural — 喜欢 is a state.
别 is a command.
questions.translation: It's not that he doesn't like you — he's just too shy to say it.

questions.prompt: {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{衣服|yīfu}{好看|hǎokàn}（　）{好看|hǎokàn}，{但是|dànshì}{太|tài}{贵|guì}{了|le}。
notes: 好看都好看 isn't the pattern.
好看也好看 isn't the pattern.
好看就好看 isn't the pattern.
questions.translation: This piece of clothing looks nice, sure, but it's too expensive.

questions.prompt: What does 「{东西|dōngxi}{好|hǎo}{是|shì}{好|hǎo}，{就是|jiùshì}{贵|guì}{了|le}{点儿|diǎnr}。」 mean?
notes: 就是 introduces a drawback, not a reason.
好是好 concedes it IS good.
贵了点儿 = a bit expensive.
